old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a lively campfire, composed of numerous sticks and branches arranged in a circular pattern. The fire burns vigorously, with flames leaping high into the air, illuminating the surrounding area with a warm, orange glow. The wood pieces are of varying sizes and shapes, some charred from the intense heat, while others remain unburned, ready to catch fire. The background is blurred, suggesting an outdoor setting, possibly a beach or a sandy area, given the light-colored ground visible beneath the fire. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the dynamic interplay between the flames and the burning wood. The scene is serene yet energetic, capturing the essence of a peaceful evening around a campfire.

caption: The video captures a close, steady view of an outdoor campfire burning over a pile of dry twigs and small branches arranged in a criss-cross pattern on pale sandy ground. Bright yellow, orange, and white flames rise continuously from and around the sticks throughout the burning sequence. The flame body flickers and deforms over time, its height and outline shifting as tongues of fire curl, split, and sway slightly left and right. The core alternates between a broad white-hot glow and more separated orange licks, while the overall fire stays vigorously alight. The sticks and the ground appear largely fixed in position and orientation in view, so visible motion is mainly in the flames themselves. The camera appears steady, keeping the same burning structure in view.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
